guides.title: Read the operations dashboard, the audit log and the support screen

steps.1: Read "Current workload" and "Recorded processing", then "Decisions recorded, by outcome". Every figure is a count or a mean over stored rows. No model is used.
steps.2: Beside the scope statement, click "Include the sample history" to count the sample year as well, or "Leave the sample history out" to leave it out.
steps.5: Click "View details" on a row to open the event in a side panel.
steps.7: Open "Support" to answer the requests that need a reply. Use "Open" and "Answered" to change lists, then use "Send reply" after checking the reply destination.
